git add cmd/beadle-email/install.go cmd/beadle-email/install_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(install): report the effective config, not a forced root path

install's doctor step no longer forces -c/--config to the just-written
root file. That defeated the fix's whole point: a user with an
identity-scoped config would see install report OK against an
irrelevant root file while every other command defers to a different
(possibly corrupt) config nothing just checked. doctorConfig's own
default is already the correct fallback for loadConfigForCmd, so
install now matches what a bare `doctor` reports immediately after.
EOF
)"
